evidence.locator: Section 2.53, printed p. 83 / one-based PDF p. 87, lower-left heading and right column: RCA sample X-9, qualitative high purity, solid-state reaction at 1500 degrees C for a phosphor project, and orthorhombic forsterite description with presumed space-group comparison.

identity_crosswalk.note: Mg2SiO4 has no standalone composition identity match among the pinned 1100 core identities or 24 accepted computed reduced compositions. Names, aliases, state/source composition descriptions and computed element maps were checked. Constituent mentions, suppliers, phases and preparation temperatures do not add identity credit. The source only presumes the forsterite space group by comparison with olivine; this is not an independently established space-group assignment. Historical natural Vesuvius forsterite and iron-bearing olivine comparisons are not the selected RCA specimen and do not establish iron in it. High purity remains qualitative. No numerical particle size is inferred from the finely powdered description.
